title: Enjoining order sought against occupant over alleged subletting and illegal activities
byline: The District Court of Mount Lavinia has been moved to issue an enjoining order against a defendant, accused of unlawfully subletting a disputed property in Dehiwala and carrying out unauthorised activities on the premises.

title: UN torture prevention body to visit Sri Lanka again
byline: The UN Subcommittee on Prevention of Torture (SPT) will return to Sri Lanka from 15 to 24 June, seven years after its last visit, to assess whether the authorities have followed through on reforms and strengthened protections for people in detention or other places where they may be deprived of their liberty, according to a statement from the UN in Sri Lanka.

title: Royal emerge unbeaten champions in U-20 All Island Hockey; Stefan, Savain excel
byline: Royal College, Colombo, emerged unbeaten champions in the All Island Under-20 Hockey tournament, beating defending champions St. Thomas College, Matale in a nail-biting sudden death penalty strokes held at Rajarata University Ground, Mihintale on Wednesday (May 27).

title: Sri Lanka’s Nazri Nizar elected to YPO global board in historic first
byline: For the first time in the 76-year history of the Young Presidents’ Organisation (YPO), a Sri Lankan has been elected to its global board, with business leader Nazri Nizar securing a position on the governing body of one of the world’s most influential leadership organisations.

title: Police tighten grip on noisy vehicles and drug-impaired driving
byline: In response to a surge in public complaints and reports of reckless driving, the Sri Lanka Police have launched a nationwide operation targeting vehicles with modified or excessively loud exhaust systems, with authorities now impounding offending vehicles instead of issuing routine traffic fines.

title: Family discovers wrong body after taking it home for burial
byline: The misidentification of two bodies at the Monaragala General Hospital resulted in considerable inconvenience to relatives.

title: Sri Lanka among countries to benefit from ADB’s US $ 4bn crisis package
byline: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has announced a US $ 4 billion financing package to help the countries cope with the economic fallout from the ongoing West Asia conflict, with Sri Lanka among 15 governments that have formally requested support.

title: CMTA warns of another Rs.40bn revenue leak from used vehicle tax break
byline: Sri Lanka risks losing another Rs.40 billion in tax revenue this year, unless the authorities urgently scrap a long-contested concession granted on the used vehicle imports, according to the Ceylon Motor Traders’ Association (CMTA), which argued the measure is creating an unjustifiable advantage for the importers while depriving the Treasury of the much-needed funds.

title: Sri Lanka and India discuss labour law reform and knowledge sharing at ILC
byline: On June 10, 2026, Labour Minister and Finance and Planning Deputy Minister Dr. Anil Jayantha Fernando held a bilateral meeting with India’s Labour and Employment State Minister Shobha Karandlaje, on the sidelines of the International Labour Conference (ILC).

title: Elon Musk Becomes the World’s First Trillionaire. What Does $1 Trillion Mean in Sri Lankan Rupees?
byline: The SpaceX IPO pushes Musk past $1 trillion this month. Here is what that number actually looks like for Sri Lanka.

title: CSE surges as peace deal optimism sparks broad-based rally
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) staged a strong recovery on Friday, with both benchmark indices posting significant gains as investor sentiment improved sharply following positive developments surrounding geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.

title: Empty seats at World Cup match renews concerns over ticket prices
byline: FIFA reported an attendance of 44,985 for Thursday’s World Cup ​match between South Korea and the Czech Republic in ‌Guadalajara, but swathes of empty seats around the stadium renewed concerns over ticket pricing and demand for the expanded tournament.

title: Online Safety Bill to be repealed this month
byline: Parliament is to take up the debate on the Online Safety (Repeal) Bill on June 23 as per the decision made by the party leaders, the office of the Leader of the House said.

title: Facebook and Instagram down for millions as users report issues
byline: Facebook and several other Meta-owned platforms appear to have gone down worldwide, leaving millions of users unable to access their accounts.

title: U.S.-Iran peace memorandum could be signed on Sunday in Geneva, source says
byline: A memorandum between the United States and Iran to halt the war in ​the Gulf could be signed as soon as Sunday, a Western source told Reuters on Friday, with Geneva emerging as the likeliest venue.

title: Port City Colombo pitches Sri Lanka as South Asia gateway at high-level Dubai investment forum
byline: Sri Lanka stepped up efforts to attract Gulf investment this week as nearly 200 senior business and diplomatic leaders gathered in Dubai for a high-level forum positioning Port City Colombo as a gateway to South Asia.

title: Sri Lanka among countries to benefit from ADB’s $4Bn crisis package
byline: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has announced a $4 billion financing package to help countries cope with the economic fallout from the ongoing West Asia conflict, with Sri Lanka among 15 governments that have formally requested support.

title: FIFA to support construction of international football stadium in Sri Lanka
byline: Sri Lanka is set to receive FIFA support for the construction of a new international football stadium in Negombo, a move expected to strengthen the country’s sports tourism sector and football infrastructure, Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism Vijitha Herath said yesterday.

title: Kane Williamson retires from international cricket
byline: New Zealand’s most prolific all-format run-scorer and widely regarded as one of the country’s greatest-ever batters, Kane Williamson has announced his retirement from international cricket with immediate effect.

title: Committee appointed to oversee SriLankan Airlines restructuring
byline: The Cabinet of Ministers has approved the appointment of a high-level committee to carry out a strategic review and restructuring of SriLankan Airlines, aiming to establish a more financially sustainable and commercially efficient national carrier.

title: Attorney General withdraws move to call judge as witness
byline: The Attorney General gave an undertaking before the Court of Appeal that an Awissawella High Court judge would not be called as a witness before the Colombo High Court in relation to judicial decisions made in the course of his official duties.

title: Colombo declared high-risk as special dengue control week announced
byline: A special dengue control week will be launched across the Colombo District from June 15 to 21 amid concerns over the rapid spread of the disease, with health authorities identifying Colombo as a high-risk district.

title: Sri Lanka on the brink of climate whiplash: Sajith
byline: Sri Lanka is on the brink of a climate whiplash as it will be hit by extreme El Nino conditions soon, Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa told Parliament today.

title: Denied a US visa to watch the World Cup? Have a free TV, says Argentine company
byline: Dozens of Argentines who were denied ​visas to travel to the United States to ‌see the World Cup will at least have a new free television to watch the games.

title: 2026 FIFA World Cup Schedule in Sri Lankan Standard Time
byline: Stay updated with the FIFA World Cup 2026 schedule in Sri Lankan Standard Time (SLST), including all match fixtures, kickoff times, and key games. This complete guide helps Sri Lankan football fans follow every match live, from late-night kickoffs to early morning clashes. title: Rupee weakens further against USD
byline: The Sri Lankan rupee weakened further against the US dollar today (12), with several commercial banks recording higher exchange rates compared to Thursday.

title: Ex-South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol sentenced to 30 years in jail over Pyongyang drone plot
byline: A South Korean court sentenced former President Yoon Suk Yeol to 30 years in prison on Friday over charges linked to military drones sent over Pyongyang to help create a pretext for his failed December 2024 martial law declaration, Yonhap reported.

title: Defence Ministry fast-tracks veteran welfare
byline: Deputy Minister of Defence, Aruna Jayasekara, chaired a special discussion at the Parliament Complex aimed at accelerating welfare assistance for Tri-Forces and Police personnel, including members of the Special Task Force (STF), who sustained disabilities due to terrorist activities during the country’s conflict.

title: Ragama Hospital equipment restored, saving millions
byline: The Ministry of Science and Technology said that medical and technological equipment worth nearly Rs. 3 million at the Rheumatology and Rehabilitation Hospital in Ragama, which had been out of service for several years, was repaired and refurbished for less than Rs. 5,000 by engineers from the Arthur C. Clarke Institute for Modern Technologies (ACCIMT).

title: Former Chief Minister Shan Wijayalal de Silva granted bail
byline: Former Southern Province Chief Minister and another suspect, who are accused of misusing public funds by distributing chairs to Southern Provincial Council members outside the government procurement process ahead of a Provincial Council election, were ordered to be released on bail by Colombo Chief Magistrate Asanga S. Bodaragama.

title: SpaceX IPO makes Elon Musk the world’s first trillionaire
byline: Few business leaders have been as deeply embedded in popular culture as Elon Musk, the ambitious entrepreneur who has become a central figure in internet culture and amassed a fortune that has ​made him the world’s first trillionaire.

title: Deal to end fighting would lead to Hormuz reopening, Iran says
byline: A deal with the US to end fighting in Iran is close and includes reopening the Strait of Hormuz, Iran’s Foreign Minister has said

byline: The FIFA World Cup 2026 group stage tables are updated live as the tournament unfolds. Track the latest standings, goal differences, and qualification scenarios for all 12 groups right here, from the opening match on June 11 through to the final group stage fixtures on June 27.

title: Bangladesh cricketer Nayeem Hasan alleges police harassment in Chattogram
byline: Bangladesh Test off-spinner Nayeem Hasan has alleged that he was harassed and assaulted by members of a law enforcement agency in his hometown of Chattogram on Saturday night, with local police authorities promising a full investigation into the incident.

title: No visas, Rugby players damned
byline: Parliament questions lethargy of Sri Lanka Rugby and Sports Minister as team is held back from Korean contest

title: Former MPs urge rule of law in Suresh Saleh case
byline: A group of former Members of Parliament has written to President Anura Kumara Dissanayake urging the government to uphold the rule of law amid growing controversy over the treatment of former State Intelligence Service Director General Major General (Retired) Suresh Saleh, who is currently in police custody.

title: Train derails in Rambukkana
byline: A train operating in the Rambukkana area derailed while in service today, according to the Railway Department of Sri Lanka.

title: Vesak festival held at White House in conjunction with international Vesak 2026
byline: A Vesak Festival was held at the White House, the official residence of the President of the United States, in conjunction with the 2026 International Vesak Festival, bringing together Buddhist clergy and devotees from diverse traditions.

title: Fishermen warned against venturing into Northern waters
byline: The Department of Meteorology has issued a warning for rough sea conditions and strong winds around the island over the next 24 hours, urging naval and fishing communities to exercise extreme caution.

title: Govt tightens controls on plastic imports
byline: The government is set to strengthen legal and operational mechanisms to curb the importation of plastics and prevent the entry of clinical waste into Sri Lanka, following a high-level discussion between the Ministry of Environment and the Sri Lanka Customs Department aimed at enhancing environmental security and biosecurity.

title: Prime Minister assures action to protect indigenous land
byline: Prime Minister has assured swift action to address issues affecting Sri Lanka’s indigenous Vedda community, including safeguarding their traditional land rights, following a meeting with indigenous leader  at Parliament yesterday (12).

title: SpaceX IPO makes Elon Musk the world’s first trillionaire
byline: Few business leaders have been as deeply embedded in popular culture as Elon Musk, the ambitious entrepreneur who has become a central figure in internet culture and amassed a fortune that has ​made him the world’s first trillionaire.

title: Song, dance and protests at World Cup
byline: The 2026 World Cup began in Mexico City with an opening ceremony filled with colour, dancing and a performance by global music star Shakira.

title: Environmental protection needs public participation beyond laws: Minister
byline: Environmental protection cannot be achieved through legislation alone and requires broad public participation and continuous dialogue across all sectors of society, Environment Minister Dr. Dammika Patabendi said during a stakeholder consultation on the amended National Environmental Act, which is scheduled to be debated in Parliament on June 24.

title: Joint Opposition seeks dialogue with CIABOC chief
byline: The Joint Opposition sought a dialogue with Committee to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) Chairman Neal Iddawela to discuss complaints lodged with the Commission against members of the government.

title: UAE to unlock billions of dollars for Iran: Reuters
byline: The United Arab Emirates has agreed to unlock billions of dollars for Iran, four sources said, in a tactical shift after weeks ​of Iranian attacks on the wealthy Gulf Arab state during the U.S.-Israeli war with the Islamic Republic.

title: First-ever orthodox bishop ordination ceremony held in Sri Lanka
byline: In a historic first for Sri Lanka, the Orthodox Traditional Christian Church held a bishop consecration ceremony in the country today at St. Peter’s Cathedral in Kandana.

title: Move to abolish NWP Environment Authority?
byline: As a question was raised by an Opposition MP in Parliament as to whether there is a move by the government to abolish the statute on environment approved by the North Western Provincial Council which led to the establishment of the North Western Province (NWP) Environment Authority, the ruling party informed that its intention is to introduce a single environment law to the entire nation.

title: ‘Not only money, even allegations end up in wrong accounts’ – Namal
byline: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) National Organizer and MP Namal Rajapaksa alleged that under the current administration, not only public funds but even allegations and responsibility for failures are being directed to the wrong places.

title: Minor flood situation reported in Kuda Ganga sub-basin
byline: A minor flood situation has been reported in the Kuda Ganga sub-basin of the Kalu River Basin following significant rainfall in the upper catchment areas, according to authorities.

title: Education will be protected in any crisis: PM
byline: Prime Minister and Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education Dr. Harini Amarasuriya says the government is firmly committed to protecting education in the face of any global crisis, stressing that significant budget allocations have been made for human resource development despite economic challenges.

title: Disabled university students to receive Rs. 5,000 allowance
byline: University students with disabilities have started receiving a monthly allowance of Rs. 5,000, with payments and outstanding arrears being disbursed from this month, according to the University Grants Commission (UGC).

title: Local organic ingredients to boost farmers and tourism: PM
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya has said that the use of locally produced organic agricultural products in bakery items would be a significant boost for local farmers while also contributing to the growth of Sri Lanka’s tourism industry.

title: Trump’s name removed from Kennedy Center in predawn operation
byline: Workers stripped U.S. President Donald Trump’s name from the Kennedy Center early on Saturday, less than six months after it went up, complying with a judge’s ruling that the performing arts landmark cannot be renamed without an act of Congress.

title: Prime Minister meets UNICEF delegation
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya met with a delegation from UNICEF on June 12 at Temple Trees to discuss ongoing efforts to support the recovery of the education sector following the impact of Cyclone Ditwah.

title: Heavy showers forecast in several areas over next 36 hours
byline: The Meteorology Department has issued the general weather forecast for the next 36 hours.

title: Pakistan PM says US-Iran peace deal signing expected within 24 hours
byline: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz ​Sharif said on ‌Saturday that the United States and ​Iran have ​agreed to a framework ⁠for a ​peace deal that ​would end the months-long conflict in the Middle ​East, with ​a final text of ‌the ⁠deal reached.

title: NBRO updates landslide early warning
byline: The National Building Research Organization (NBRO) has updated its landslide early warning notice due to the prevailing rainy weather conditions.

title: Chinese-owned supermarket raided over consumer law violations
byline: The Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA) has conducted a raid on a supermarket operated by a Chinese company in the Kollupitiya area, which is alleged to have sold goods in violation of Sri Lanka’s consumer protection laws.

title: Gold fever sends some vintage luxury watches to the melting furnace
byline: Omega’s Constellation watch has been flashed in campaigns, movies and at the Met Gala by stars like George Clooney and ​Nicole Kidman, turning it into a symbol of luxury and glamour.

title: Iran and US close on initial deal, Tehran says no signing on Sunday
byline: Iran said on Saturday ​it could sign the framework for a peace deal with the United States in the coming days, but dismissed a suggestion by mediator Pakistan that it would be signed ‌within the next 24 hours.
